channel.title: Rafael M. Batista — Notes
channel.description: A commonplace notebook by Rafael M. Batista — passages, observations, and ideas I want to hold on to.

item.title: From: Claude Design; For: Researchers
item.description: On Friday, Anthropic Labs released a preview of Claude Design, an entirely new way to interact with Claude to create visual work like "designs, prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and more." The video blew me away — then I tried it, and imagined a different product built for researchers instead.

item.title: Trails and public spaces
item.description: Kenny Peng and colleagues propose a new design for social media: rather than feeds — where there's only one direction to move in — a better design would facilitate trails. A reply on why the campground or the piazza may be the better analogy.

item.title: The family we draw
item.description: I married my wife a few months ago, in December of 2025. Friends have since asked whether it feels any different — and there is one thing that feels fundamentally different, illustrated by a simple thought experiment: how would you draw your family?
